Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE final production transparent PNG sprite for a high quality playful mobile stacking game.
A wide stocky toy refrigerator character: complete body silhouette width 110 and height 133 proportionally. White enamel upper freezer and larger lower door, ice-blue casing, two friendly googly eyes INSIDE the upper door, short glossy blue handles inside the left edges, one yellow-gold star magnet INSIDE the lower door. Lovely entertainment character, crisp dimensional casually painted 3D toy-like materials and highlights, not photograph, not flat clipart.
CRITICAL OUTER SILHOUETTE: exactly an EIGHT-SIDED RECTANGLE WITH VERY SMALL STRAIGHT CHAMFERED CORNERS. Imagine a perfect rectangle whose four corners each have a tiny 45-degree straight cut only 3% of total width. Long perfectly straight HORIZONTAL top edge, long perfectly straight HORIZONTAL bottom edge, long perfectly straight VERTICAL left and right edges, four tiny STRAIGHT 45-degree diagonal bevels at corners. No large rounded outer corners. No curves or humps on the outside contour. No external rounded roof cap. No separate plinth, feet or indentation. It must have the outline of a wide rectangular storage box with 8 straight edges. This shape is essential for one simple physical collider.
Create all appealing roundness, gloss, enamel shading and bevel lighting INSIDE that simple octagonal body outline. Interior door panels can have rounded corners, the eyes can be rounded and juicy, but exterior silhouette MUST have only straight edges and tiny diagonal corners. Straight-on ORTHOGRAPHIC front view, no isometric angle and no deep perspective.
Composition: centered, complete uncropped single object, body ratio 110 wide to 133 tall, transparent 6% margin. Genuine transparent alpha background. No cast shadow, no floor, no glow, no background, no extra objects, no text, no watermark. Blue outline belongs to the body, no sticking-out details. Broad real flat top and broad real flat bottom each span 94% of body width.
